text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Cheval Grand is pointing,
I see a crane game filled with plushies
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A new one came out, huh...
............

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's get going, Trainer.
If someone wants to play, we'll just be in the way...
choice_data_list: ...Well then, maybe I'll hang out and play here!
...Well then, maybe I'll hang out and play here!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: I thought it might be good fishing practice!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
F-Fishing practice...?
Come to think of it... it might be a little similar.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll be cheering for you...
Good luck, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
